India's Nikita Porwal Competes in Miss World 2026 Finale

Nikita Porwal, Femina Miss India World 2024, is representing India at the Miss World 2026 pageant, which is scheduled to take place today in Nha Trang, Vietnam. Indian viewers can watch the event live on JioHotstar starting at 5:30 pm IST. One report mentioned Porwal is wearing a gown inspired by Princess Diana's sapphire ring.
